shared_elements: low-relief carving of forms on a flat-ish surface
oval/rounded enclosed shape (a ring or spiral in A, a cartouche in B)
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry shallow relief carving including a rounded enclosed form (a spiral/ring in A, an oval cartouche enclosing signs in B). Otherwise the depicted content is entirely different: A shows fleshy figural imagery with faces, eyes, limbs and hands crowded organically over the rock, while B shows an ordered field of abstract script-like signs set between vertical bands filled with chevrons and tick marks, with no figures at all.
